synopsis: The corpus provides no verified GMG-specific basis for planning virtual validation of off-road collision mitigation or automatic braking systems [f1698, f2602, f7748]. The precedents review found no GMG study on applying OpenSCENARIO, ISO 34502 or the UNECE New Assessment/Test Method to off-road machines; this is a search gap, not proof that such studies do not exist [f1698]. The rules and acceptance-criteria chapter reports that GMG guidelines were not verified [f2602]. The simulation-trust chapter likewise leaves GMG specifics unverified, so the supplied facts establish neither GMG acceptance criteria nor GMG conditions for trusting simulation [f2602, f7748].
